name: The Scythe of Elune
summary: The Scythe of Elune is an Alliance investigation bridging an ancient night elf relic in Kalimdor with the sudden worgen infestation plaguing Duskwood. Sent by Jonathan Carevin in Darkshire, adventurers delve into the haunted depths of Roland's Doom to uncover what brought these ravenous beasts to the Eastern Kingdoms.

sections.title: A Hunt in the Dark
sections.body: After tracing the enigmatic Priestess Velinde Starsong across Kalimdor and speaking with the Carevin household in Darkshire, travelers find common cause with Jonathan Carevin. The Nightbane worgen have overrun southern Duskwood, pushing out miners and threatening what little remains of the township. Although Carevin does not fully grasp the supernatural origin of these beasts, he recognizes the value of someone willing to root them out, pointing searchers toward Roland's Doom—the very mine where the fiends were first sighted.

sections.title: Ghosts of Roland's Doom
sections.body: Deeper within Roland's Doom, amidst packs of vicious Nightbane, lies an undisturbed mound of earth. Disturbing the soil reveals a lingering specter of Velinde Starsong herself. The ghostly manifestation confirms that the night elf priestess made her way into this wretched cave carrying the Scythe of Elune, but met a tragic and mysterious end beneath the soil of Duskwood. Her demise left the staff vulnerable, directly unleashing the worgen scourge across the realm.

faq.q: Where do I look for signs of the Scythe?
faq.answer: Head into Roland's Doom, an abandoned mine located in southeastern Duskwood. Fight your way through the Nightbane worgen to an undisturbed pile of earth inside the tunnels.

Jonathan Carevin is a member of the Carevin family residing in Darkshire. Faced with dwindling defenders against evil, he eagerly trades information with outsiders who seek to cull the dangerous worgen numbers.

faq.q: What happened to Velinde Starsong in the mine?
faq.answer: Deep inside Roland's Doom, an undisturbed pile of earth holds the answer to Velinde's fate and the Scythe's whereabouts. Examining it reveals the story you carry back to Jonathan Carevin.

faq.q: What is the Scythe of Elune?
faq.answer: The Scythe of Elune is a sacred night elf artifact that Priestess Velinde Starsong received, which the Sentinels believe was granted to her as a boon by the goddess Elune.

faq.q: Why did the worgen appear in Duskwood?
faq.answer: According to Jonathan Carevin, the worgen appeared out of nowhere, and the mine of Roland's Doom to the south is where they were first found. Searching that mine for signs of the Scythe of Elune uncovers the reason.
Calor is an associate of the Carevin family in Darkshire whom Jonathan instructs to focus entirely on containing the worgen threat following your discoveries in Roland's Doom.

angles.text: Finding the final resting place of Priestess Velinde Starsong reveals the terrible price paid when the Scythe of Elune slipped beyond the supervision of the Sisterhood.
Unraveling the mystery of the Nightbane worgen provides Darkshire and the Alliance with their first real answers regarding the horrors stalking southern Duskwood.
The wild and untamed worgen summoned by the Scythe carry deep roots in primordial pack magic, offering druids a sober warning about forces beyond control.
